achieved.claim: Consolidated revenues for Q4 stood at INR2,127 crore with an EBITDA of INR383 crore.
EBITDA margins improved significantly to 18% during Q4 FY26 compared to 11% in Q3 FY26.
Profit after tax stood at INR220 crore, registering a growth of 120% quarter-on-quarter.
Advanced intermediates revenue reached INR708 crore with EBIT improving to INR34 crore.

pushback.concern: Nitric acid plant utilization was low and questioned if INR90-100 crore EBITDA target is on track.
Propylene availability constraints and price spreads between China and India in Phenolics.
Receivable days have increased; asked for reasons behind the rise.
Advanced Intermediates business appears underutilized compared to historical numbers.

output.tone_why: Management highlighted robust sequential growth, proactive raw material stocking, and strong integration benefits despite volatility.
